Provide lifelong vet care and financial support for retired service animals

Reduce the retirement age for the NHS pension scheme to 60
Reinstate mandatory warning before seizing a vehicle for anti-social driving
Ban children & their likeness being used to promote pornography or adult-content
Introduce urgent moratorium on AI Data Centres and BESS outside AI Growth Zones

Fund £20,000 a year (term time) wage for Teaching Assistants

Keep 10-year Long Residence Route for people already living in the UK
Require public bodies to achieve unqualified audit opinion before raising taxes

Disapprove the draft Equality Act 2010 guidance laid on 21 May 2026
